messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: canary deployment inference-runtime-gpu-1 in namespace=prod-runtime reporting CrashLoopBackOff x10. severity=page, impacted_routes=/v1/generate (partial). docs: runbook/gpu-canary.md :rotating_light:
amy_oncall: got the page, looking now. can anyone confirm customer-facing errors?@jordan_support?
jordan_support: seeing ~12% 500s for some customers in EU region since 09:02 UTC, support queue has two tickets. not full outage but elevated errors and latency.
raj_sre: attaching quick check: `kubectl -n prod-runtime get pods -l app=inference-runtime-canary -o wide` shows pods scheduling on nodes without nvidia.com/gpu label -> CrashLoop because container expects GPU. suspect label-selector mismatch in the canary manifest.
max_eng: uhh that sounds like the new nodeSelector key slipped in the kustomize overlay. I pushed a change earlier to add `nodeSelector: { accelerator: nvidia-a100 }` but cluster uses `nvidia.com/gpu: present` labels for autoscaling. bad mapping.
lina_devops: confirming: node-pool-autoscaler has nodes with label `nvidia.com/gpu=true` but our selector uses `accelerator=nvidia-a100`. nothing matches so kube schedules onto CPU-only nodes which don't have drivers -> crash.
amy_oncall: mitigation options? fast: patch canary to remove nodeSelector, or scale down canary and flip feature flag kill-switch.
max_eng: feature flag exists: `runtime_canary_gpu_v2` in LaunchDarkly. I can flip to false now to stop routing traffic to the canary. that should reduce customer impact immediately.
raj_sre: agree, flip flag first. then roll back manifest change in the canary deployment.
claudia_pm: do we have a rollback window? customers on trial are affected; prefer kill-switch then follow with rollback. notify customers?
jordan_support: will send an update to affected customers post-mitigation — OK with kill-switch first.
amy_oncall: @max_eng please flip the flag and post confirm. also set an incident channel note in status page if it persists.
max_eng: flipped `runtime_canary_gpu_v2 -> false` at 09:07 UTC :white_check_mark: routing to stable.
incident-bot: Event: feature-flag-toggle by max_eng (LD). Alert suppressed.
raj_sre: after flag flip traffic to canary dropped to ~2% and errors on /v1/generate fell to baseline in EU within 30s. good.
lina_devops: patching manifest now to remove wrong nodeSelector and redeploy canary with correct `nodeSelector: { "nvidia.com/gpu": "present" }` or preferably use nodeAffinity. applying quick patch: `kubectl -n prod-runtime patch deploy inference-runtime-canary -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"nodeSelector":null}}}}'`
max_eng: rolling restart triggered for canary pods. watching logs.
raj_sre: also noticed HPA for canary had maxReplicas=2 (too small) and minReplicas=0, which made recovery churn worse when pods kept dying. we'll open a follow-up to tighten HPA to min=1, max=6 for canary.
amy_oncall: recording mitigation steps: 1) flip feature flag 2) patch manifest to remove bad selector 3) restart canary 4) update HPA bounds 5) postmortem. Who will own follow-ups?
lina_devops: I'll own the HPA/cluster label mapping doc updates and a small test to validate nodeSelector keys in CI.
max_eng: I'll own changes to kustomize overlays and add a lint rule to catch unknown nodeSelector keys.
raj_sre: I'll run postmortem playbook, collect timestamps, and nominate SLO blameless review.
claudia_pm: please include customer impact summary for comms — Jordan will draft update once we have final timeline.
jordan_support: draft prepared, will wait for timeline then send to affected customers.
amy_oncall: current status: service routing reverted to stable, canary pods stable on restart, errors back to normal. keeping this thread open for handoff.
incident-bot: ONCALL HANDOFF scheduled: amy_oncall -> raj_sre at 11:00 UTC (next shift). escalate if regressions after rollback.
amy_oncall: handing off to @raj_sre for postmortem and follow-ups. I'll be available for 30m for questions.
raj_sre: taking over. I'll run through runbook, collect logs: `kubectl -n prod-runtime describe pod <crashloop-pod>` and kubelet logs from nodes that scheduled the pod.
max_eng: pushed a hotfix PR to kustomize overlays and will gate it behind CI integration test for node labels. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtimes/pull/482 :rocket:
lina_devops: I'll add an automation job to check that nodeSelector keys map to an existing node label set in each environment.
claudia_pm: thanks team. rough customer impact: ~12% errors for a subset in EU for ~5 minutes; support tickets opened. we'll include that in the incident summary.
raj_sre: logging timeline and marking incident as mitigated. moving to postmortem draft channel.
amy_oncall: closing the immediate page, tracking follow-ups in #incidents-postmortems. :thumbsup:
